sn35.155:1.1: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn35.155:1.2: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘a speaker on the Dhamma, a speaker on the Dhamma.’
sn35.155:1.3: In what way, venerable sir, is one a speaker on the Dhamma?”
sn35.155:2.1: “Bhikkhu, if one teaches the Dhamma for the purpose of revulsion towards the eye, for its fading away and cessation, one can be called a bhikkhu who is a speaker on the Dhamma.
sn35.155:2.2: If one is practising for the purpose of revulsion towards the eye, for its fading away and cessation, one can be called a bhikkhu who is practising in accordance with the Dhamma.
sn35.155:2.3: If, through revulsion towards the eye, through its fading away and cessation, one is liberated by nonclinging, one can be called a bhikkhu who has attained Nibbāna in this very life.
sn35.155:2.4: “Bhikkhu, if one teaches the Dhamma for the purpose of revulsion towards the ear …
sn35.155:2.5: for the purpose of revulsion towards the mind, for its fading away and cessation, one can be called a bhikkhu who is a speaker on the Dhamma.
sn35.155:2.6: If one is practising for the purpose of revulsion towards the mind, for its fading away and cessation, one can be called a bhikkhu who is practising in accordance with the Dhamma.
sn35.155:2.7: If, through revulsion towards the mind, through its fading away and cessation, one is liberated by nonclinging, one can be called a bhikkhu who has attained Nibbāna in this very life.”
